title: Jumps that feel good
description:
Add coyote time and jump buffering, two small tricks that make jumping feel fair.

```
left the ledge 0.05 s ago, pressed jump -> jumps (coyote time 0.1 s)
pressed jump 0.08 s before landing     -> jumps on landing (buffer 0.1 s)
held jump: full height; released early: cut speed in half
```
hints: Each frame: add `dt` to both timers, reset `sinceGround` when on the ground and `sincePressed` when the button is pressed (lesson 3.03).
Upward speed is negative in screen coordinates: rising means `vy < 0`.
requirements: Track time since last on the ground and time since jump was pressed.
Jump when both are within their windows; then clear both.
Releasing the button while rising halves the upward speed (variable jump height).
stretch: Make gravity stronger while falling than while rising.
